high_level_description: The image is a humorous meme featuring two panels of the character Thanos from the Marvel Cinematic Universe. In the top left panel, Thanos has a full, green beard that covers his chin and extends slightly onto his chest. His expression is neutral, and he appears to be looking directly at the viewer. The top right panel shows Thanos with a clean-shaven face, revealing his characteristic purple skin and deep wrinkles. He is smiling widely, showing his teeth. Below these panels, there is an advertisement for a Gillette Mach3 razor. The razor is designed to look like Thanos's hammer, Mjolnir,
